title: Internal: assembling the final settled refund figure for a class-credit pack
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states how the final settled refund figure for a pack's unused credits is assembled from its two preceding adjustments.

## Basis
The final figure paid out is the refund figure reached after the no-show deduction step, plus the corporate wellness loyalty bonus, if any. The two figures are added together — the bonus is added on top of the after-deduction figure, never subtracted, and combined by straightforward addition only. Where no loyalty bonus applies, the final figure equals the after-deduction figure unchanged. Once assembled, the final figure is rounded to two decimal places.

## Ordering note
The no-show deduction step is applied before the loyalty bonus is considered: the bonus, where it applies, is calculated on the figure that already reflects that deduction, not on any earlier, undeducted figure. Reversing the order — computing a bonus on the undeducted figure and only then subtracting the outstanding no-show charge — would reach a different, and incorrect, final figure whenever both adjustments apply to the same refund.

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, the figure after the no-show deduction were $70.00, and a loyalty bonus of $4.20 applied on top. The final figure paid out is $70.00 plus $4.20, namely $74.20, rounded to two decimal places.
